description: Words of Jesus Christ (red letter edition)
note: This contains the actual words spoken by Jesus in each verse. For verses where Jesus speaks the entire verse, the value is 'full'. For partial verses, the exact quoted words are provided.

verses.Matthew 3:15: Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness.
verses.Matthew 4:4: It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.Matthew 4:7: It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.Matthew 4:10: Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.Matthew 4:17: Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.Matthew 4:19: Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.Matthew 5:3: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.Matthew 5:4: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.Matthew 5:5: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.Matthew 5:6: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.Matthew 5:7: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.Matthew 5:8: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.Matthew 5:9: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.Matthew 5:10: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.Matthew 5:11: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.Matthew 5:12: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.Matthew 5:13: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.Matthew 5:14: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.Matthew 5:15: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.Matthew 5:16: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.Matthew 5:17: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.Matthew 5:18: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.Matthew 5:19: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.Matthew 5:20: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.Matthew 11:28: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
verses.Matthew 11:29: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
verses.Matthew 11:30: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
verses.Matthew 28:18: All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
verses.Matthew 28:19: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
verses.Matthew 28:20: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.
verses.Mark 1:15: The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
verses.Mark 1:17: Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
verses.Mark 10:14: Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
verses.Mark 10:15: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
verses.Mark 10:27: With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
verses.Mark 16:15: Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.Mark 16:16: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.Luke 6:27: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.Luke 6:31: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.Luke 6:37: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.Luke 19:10: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
verses.Luke 23:34: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.
verses.Luke 23:43: Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
verses.Luke 23:46: Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit:
verses.John 1:50: Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.John 1:51: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.John 3:3: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
verses.John 3:5: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.John 3:7: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.John 3:16: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.John 3:17: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.John 3:18: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
verses.John 4:10: If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.John 4:13: Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.John 4:14: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.John 4:26: I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.John 5:8: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.John 6:20: It is I; be not afraid.
verses.John 6:35: I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.John 8:7: He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.John 8:10: Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.John 8:11: Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.John 8:12: I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.John 8:32: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.John 8:58: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.John 10:7: Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.John 10:9: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
verses.John 10:10: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
verses.John 10:11: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
verses.John 10:14: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
verses.John 10:27: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
verses.John 10:28: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
verses.John 10:30: I and my Father are one.
verses.John 11:25: I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.John 11:26: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.John 13:34: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.John 14:1: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.John 14:2: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.John 14:3: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
verses.John 14:6: I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
verses.John 14:15: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
verses.John 14:27: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
verses.John 15:1: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.John 15:2: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.John 15:4: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.John 15:5: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.John 15:12: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.John 15:13: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.John 16:33: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
verses.John 20:17: Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
verses.John 20:29: Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
verses.John 21:15: Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these?
verses.Revelation 1:8: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.Revelation 1:11: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last:
verses.Revelation 1:17: Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.Revelation 1:18: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.Revelation 22:12: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verses.Revelation 22:13: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
verses.Revelation 22:16: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
